original_text: I agree that students should do homework at school. At home there are many distractions, like the phone and the TV. In school a teacher can help when we dont understand something. For example, last month I could not solve a math problem at home and I spent two hours, but in class my teacher explained it in five minutes.

I disagree with this idea. Homework at home teach students to be responsible and organize their time. School day is already long and students need a break. Also parents can see what their children learn when they do homework at home.

Homework is very important for students. Many students in my country have a lot of homework every day. Some subjects like math and english have more homework than other subjects. I think teachers should give interesting homework so students will like it more and they will learn better.

In my opinion doing homework in school is better. First, students can work together with classmates and help each other. Second, they will have free time at home for sport and family. My brother always do his homework in the school library and then he plays football in the evening.

The notice says that the library start a garden program on weekends. Volunteers grow vegetables behind the library on Saturday morning and the food go to the food bank. I would join because I like to be outside and I want to help people who dont have enough food. Also I dont need experience, so it is easy for me.

The library has a new program. I think gardens are very good for the town because plants make the air clean and the town looks more beautiful. In my city we have a big park with many flowers and I like walking there with my dog on weekends.

The main idea is that people can volunteer to grow vegetables for the food bank. I probably would not join, because on Saturday morning I have swimming training. But I think it is a good idea and maybe my parents will go, because tools are provided and they like gardening.
This notice is about garden program. The vegetables will be given to people. I would join it.

I think school should start one hour later. Teenagers need more sleep and in the morning many students are tired and cant concentrate. Maria said the day will be too long, but we could make the lunch break shorter, so we still finish at the same time.

I dont agree with starting later. If school start later we finish later and there is no time for clubs and homework. I agree with my classmate that the day would be too long. It is better to go to bed earlier.

Starting later is good idea because I hate waking up early. In the winter it is dark and cold in the morning and the bus is always full. Sometimes I am late for the first lesson because of the traffic.

In my opinion a later start is a good change. My classmate is worried that the day becomes too long, but I think the day would only feel long if we keep the same number of lessons. The school could move one lesson online, so we start later and finish at the same time. Students would be more awake and learn better.
